title: Rabbi Ze’ira, Reciter of Baraitot, Brother of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1, folio 6b, and the Charedim explains that he recited baraitot. In the Milchamot of the Ramban on chapter 1 of Berakhot in the Alfasi, he cites the Jerusalem Talmud with the reading: “for Rabbi Ze’ira said: The brother of Rabbi Chiyya bar Ashi taught.”

notes.text: The supplied Charedim explanation calls him a reciter of baraitot. “Tanna” here describes that role, not membership in the Mishnaic generation. The heading retains the supplied brother relationship.
The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1 has Chiyya bar Ashia and also names Rav Abba bar Chana. The heading and Hyman’s reports of Charedim and Ramban retain their distinct forms.
